name: Speed ramp
summary: Change the speed of one clip inside a single shot, from slow motion to fast play and back.
how: Set a speed curve with points at 20% and 400%.
Place the slow point on the strong beat.
Smooth the curve over 6 to 12 frames.
Add a 2px zoom or shake on the jump.

origin.note: Zack Snyder uses ramps between slow and fast motion in the fights of 300.

adoptions.via: CapCut and similar editors give a curve tool, and editors cut clips to music with ramps.
